##### 1.1.3 Central Processing Unit (CPU)

The motherboard comes with a AM4 socket for AMD Ryzen™ /7th Generation A-series / Athlon™

Processors.

PRIME X370-PRO

PRIME X370-PRO CPU socket AM4

The AM4 socket has a different pinout from the AM3+/FM2+/FM2 socket. Ensure that you use a CPU designed for the AM4 socket. The CPU fits in only one correct orientation. DO

NOT force the CPU into the socket to prevent bending the pins and damaging the CPU!

##### 1.1.4 System memory

The motherboard comes with four DDR4 (Double Data Rate 4) Quad Inline Memory Modules

(DIMM) slots.

A DDR4 module is notched differently from a DDR, DDR2, or DDR3 module. DO NOT install a DDR, DDR2, or DDR3 memory module to the DDR4 slot.
